outcome.interpretation_warning: NOT INTERPRETABLE: no individual year clears the t > 2.78 hurdle, so the fitted curve is describing the decay of a quantity that was never distinguishable from zero. Any half-life reported from it is a half-life of noise and must not be used as the framework's decay clock.
